title: Three Days and One Short Bowl
subtitle: 饮食健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）
meta: 主题语境：饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）　|　核心词汇：yoghurt　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 yoghurt 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the cook ① made the yoghurt that no guest in the canteen would have described, and he said the making was the whole of the day. The ② yoghurt, meaning the drink itself and not the bowl, ran three days and stayed undescribed in the book; yoghurt, he said, is the only thing in a canteen that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ spoonful of yoghurt in that canteen had the same short bowl beside it, and the ④ yoghurt at the far table, meaning the portion they kept for the children to share and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Yoghurt, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the cook said the describing is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the yoghurt was the whole of the matter, meaning the health and not the drink. The ⑥ yoghurt, meaning the health and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; yoghurt, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both drink and a health. He said the health is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ yoghurt had become a line in a menu, and the menu had become an argument about the short bowl. The ⑧ yoghurt of the whole thing, the cook wrote in September, was one canteen and three days of describing; yoghurt, he said, is either the portion at the far table or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ yoghurt I remember is the yoghurt described in the menu, which closed in 1987 and is still described as the quietest in the canteen. ⑩ Yoghurt, my mother said in 1989, is the only thing that improves by being described; all yoghurt, she said, is a health that has agreed to look like drink. She said the health was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 酸奶（指食堂里每一勺旁边的那一勺）
B. n. 酸奶（指那杯酸奶本身，与小小的碗相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the yoghurt 做这一杯酸奶
D. n. 酸奶（指留给孩子们分着吃的那一份）
E. n. 酸奶之事（抽象总称，指一处食堂的酸奶之事）
F. n. 酸奶（指菜单里写到、被描述的那一杯）
G. n. 酸奶、养生（指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 养生（抽象总称，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the yoghurt that no guest in the canteen would have described
The yoghurt, meaning the drink itself and not the bowl
Every spoonful of yoghurt in that canteen
the yoghurt at the far table
the yoghurt was the whole of the matter
the yoghurt had become a line in a menu
The yoghurt of the whole thing

answers.why: make the yoghurt 意为“做这一杯酸奶”，1980 年那位厨子把食堂里没有一位客人肯描述的一杯酸奶做了一遍。
yoghurt 意为“酸奶”，指那杯酸奶本身而不是小小的碗，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被描述。
yoghurt 意为“酸奶”，指食堂里每一勺旁边的那一勺，每一勺旁边都有同一只小小的碗。
yoghurt 意为“酸奶”，指最远那张桌角的留给孩子们分着吃的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
yoghurt 意为“酸奶、养生”，指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这杯养生就是那件事的全部。
yoghurt 意为“养生”，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西而不是那杯酸奶，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
yoghurt 意为“酸奶”，指菜单里写到、被描述的那一杯，到 1985 年这一杯成了菜单里的一行。
yoghurt 意为“酸奶之事”，厨子九月写道，整件事的酸奶之事是一处食堂和三个日子的描述。
yoghurt 意为“酸奶”，我记得的是菜单里描述过的那一杯，1987 年开完了，至今仍被说成食堂里最安静的一杯。
yoghurt 为抽象总称，母亲 1989 年说，酸奶是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的酸奶。
